definitions.gloss: going ahead; getting there first; cutting someone off
definitions.explanation: Physically arriving at a destination before someone else, or taking a different route to get ahead.
Acting in advance to address something before it happens, or predicting and preparing for a future situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a shortcut and got there first.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{逃|に}げ{道|みち}→逃げ道：27610_nigemichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{伏|ぶ}せた→待ち伏せる：22514_machibuseru⟧。
examples.english: They got ahead of the criminal's escape route and set up an ambush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{裏道|うらみち}→裏道：19428_uramichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to take back roads to get ahead and avoid the traffic jam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対処|たいしょ}する→対処する：20049_taishosuru⟧。
examples.english: To deal with problems by anticipating them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no point in worrying about things before they happen.

examples.english: Anticipating customer needs and developing new services is our company's strength.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead, future) and ⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (going around). Functions as both a noun and a suru verb ({先回|さきまわ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The literal sense of physically getting ahead expanded into the common figurative meaning of anticipating and acting preemptively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先回|さきまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to get ahead and wait
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先回|さきまわ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worry in advance
- {先回|さきまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to take preemptive measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先手|せんて}を{打|う}つ→先手を打つ：18391_sentewoutsu⟧: to make the first move — emphasizes taking initiative in a competitive context
- {先読|さきよ}み: foresight, reading ahead — focuses on prediction and analysis
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧: prevention — specifically about preventing problems, more formal
